name: Fluid Gore
description: Butcher's-yard gore in vanilla style: strike any part of the body and wounds open and deepen to the bone, limbs and heads come off, blood sprays and flows, and every animal screams, panics and dies in its own way. The gore works client-side on vanilla servers. With the mod on the server too, slaughtered animals stay where they fell until cleaned up, and everyone sees the same butchery.
